title: NFLProps PUBLIC_READY checkpoint publication
description: One game's consumer-facing player-prop opportunities at one official checkpoint: one row per actual sportsbook quote, priced with the certified calibrated STRUCTURAL_CORE model. Consumers (wizardofodds.com) fetch, validate and render only; they never recompute a probability. Render nothing once now >= game.expires_at (kickoff). Reference validator: nflprops.publication.consumer.validate_public_ready.

opportunity_id.description: Stable id of this book quote (game, player, prop, book, line)

line.description: Book line; null for yes/no props (anytime / first TD)

pick.description: The side with the larger model expected value at this book's price

model_probability.description: Calibrated model probability the pick wins

fair_odds.description: Model fair American odds for the pick (push-aware)

book_odds.description: The sportsbook's American odds for the pick

edge.description: Model expected profit per 1 unit staked at book_odds

projection.description: Calibrated model mean of the stat; null for yes/no props

updated_at.description: When this book quote was last observed
